focus_areas: Integrity and separation of dorsal spines (no fusion)
Texture consistency and transparency of pectoral fin membranes
Species-specific coloration patterns and stripe continuity
Edge sharpness against solid blue background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the connectivity of the dorsal spines to the main body. AI often fails to attach these thin spines correctly or merges them into a single mass. Also, verify that the white spots on the pectoral fins are distinct and not smeared into the stripes. Pay attention to the boundary between the fish and the solid blue background for any haloing or bleeding artifacts.
image_description: A side-profile view of a Red Lionfish (Pterois volitans) swimming near a textured coral reef substrate. The fish exhibits characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with spotted membranes, and prominent, separated dorsal spines. The background is a solid, vibrant blue, likely an aquarium setting or open water column.
